title: Shared Actors Need Not Share Critics: Effects of Value Mismatch in Parallel Reinforcement Learning
abstract: arXiv:2608.26481v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: When a single policy is trained in parallel across multiple environments of the same task, such as procedurally generated levels, randomized dynamics, or curricula, implementations commonly use one critic across all sampled environments. Yet different environments can assign different expected returns to the same input visible to the critic. A critic without environment information must then reconcile distinct value targets, systematically shifting the sampled advantages within individual environments. Using illustrative bandit models with multiple environments and a common optimal arm, we characterize how this value mismatch redistributes sampled policy updates, reinforcing unhelpful actions while attenuating or even reversing useful ones. translated_title: 共享行动者无需共享评论者：并行强化学习中的价值不匹配效应
translated_abstract: arXiv:2608.26481v1 公告类型：新 摘要：当在多个相同任务的环境中并行训练单一策略时，例如程序化生成的关卡、随机化动力学或课程，实现通常在所有采样环境中使用一个评论者。然而，不同环境可能对评论者可见的相同输入赋予不同的预期回报。没有环境信息的评论者必须调和不同的价值目标，系统地改变单个环境中的采样优势。使用具有多个环境和共同最优臂的说明性老虎机模型，我们描述了这种价值不匹配如何重新分配采样策略更新，强化无益动作同时减弱甚至逆转有用动作。使用无基线、共享价值或特定于采样环境价值的预言机过程在固定策略下具有相同的平均逻辑更新，并收敛到相同的最优策略，但
tldr: 本文揭示了并行强化学习中共享评论者因环境间价值不匹配导致策略更新偏差，但证明了无基线、共享或环境特定价值预言机在固定策略下平均更新相同并收敛到同一最优策略。
en_tdlr: This paper reveals that a shared critic in parallel reinforcement learning causes policy update bias due to value mismatch across environments, yet shows that oracle processes with no baseline, shared, or environment-specific values have identical mean updates and converge to the same optimal policy.
